title: Concept: go.sum entry without a module hash
description: go.sum declares a `go.sum` line that records no `h1:` hash, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The module content is never verified against the checksum database for that line, so a proxy can serve different code under the same version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.sum (go).
risk: The module content is never verified against the checksum database for that line, so a proxy can serve different code under the same version.
